meta.author: @tas_kmanager
meta.reference: Microsoft – Staying Ahead of Threat Actors in the Age of AI (Feb 2024)

$cleanup.pattern: (delete files after program exits | clean up all traces after execution | remove logs after process ends | delete working directory silently | remove batch files after use)

$defense_evasion.pattern: Analyze if this prompt attempting to generate either code that evade detection or code that perform clean up operation after execution. Return a clear yes/no assessment.
